input.prompt: Photorealistic aerial view of terraced rice paddies cascading down green hillsides after rain. Each terrace holds a thin sheet of reflective rainwater mirroring the grey-white sky. Wet, glossy earthen embankments wind in curving contour lines across the slopes. Low-lying valleys are filled with soft drifting mist that clings between the hills, with ridgelines emerging through the haze. Lush, vivid green rice plants on some terraces, pale golden stubble on others. Shot from a drone at high altitude looking down at a steep angle, natural overcast diffused light, subtle highlights on the wet water surfaces, fine detail on the textures of mud and leaves, atmospheric depth, realistic colour, documentary landscape photography.
